attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: llm_text_cleanup_via_fastapi_proxy
steps:
  - id: receive_extracted_text
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/pwa/extracted-text"
      method: "POST"
    output: raw_request

  - id: validate_request_origin
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_request
      schema:
        type: object
        required:
          - origin
          - text
        properties:
          origin:
            type: string
            enum:
              - "https://<github-pages-app>.github.io"
          text:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
    output: validated_request

  - id: extract_text_body
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_request
      field: "text"
    output: extracted_text

  - id: authenticate_proxy_service
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "proxy_service"
      description: "Authenticate the backend proxy before calling external LLM API"
    output: auth_result

  - id: prepare_llm_payload
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: extracted_text
      mapping:
        model: "gpt-4"
        messages:
          - role: "system"
            content: >
              Tu es un assistant de nettoyage de texte français. Supprime les numéros de page,
              les en-têtes courants, les notes de bas de page et les artefacts de césure.
              Retourne uniquement le texte nettoyé, sans explication.
          - role: "user"
            content: "{{input}}"
    output: llm_request_payload

  - id: call_llm_api
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: llm_request_payload
      url: "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
      method: "POST"
      headers:
        Content-Type: "application/json"
    output: raw_llm_response

  - id: validate_llm_response
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_llm_response
      schema:
        type: object
        required:
          - choices
        properties:
          choices:
            type: array
            minItems: 1
            items:
              type: object
              required:
                - message
              properties:
                message:
                  type: object
                  required:
                    - content
                  properties:
                    content:
                      type: string
    output: validated_llm_response

  - id: extract_cleaned_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_llm_response
      field: "choices[0].message.content"
    output: cleaned_text

  - id: handle_llm_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      monitored_steps:
        - call_llm_api
        - validate_llm_response
      on_error: error_retry

  - id: error_retry
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step: call_llm_api
      max_retries: 2
      backoff_seconds: 3

  - id: format_response_for_pwa
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: cleaned_text
      format: "json"
      template:
        cleaned_text: "{{input}}"
        status: "success"
    output: pwa_response

  - id: log_cleanup_request
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: pwa_response
      event: "llm_text_cleanup_completed"
      details: "Text cleanup proxy request processed successfully"

  - id: notify_pwa_frontend
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: pwa_response
      channel: "http_response"
      message: "Cleaned text ready for TTS playback"

  - id: end_workflow
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "success"
